label: The background, the Catholic theory and the existence of evil are jointly satisfiable
description: The frozen Catholic bundle retains STMT-GOD-DRAWS-GOOD-FROM-EVERY-EVIL as an open, disputed strengthening of ad 1: actual production for every existing evil with no explicit permission condition. Collective scope, permission-conditioned policy and capability readings are recorded separately in DISAMB-AD1-GOOD-FROM-EVIL. Neither this result nor its model establishes that stronger source attribution, actual divine permission, or the philosophical truth of that commitment. This is a concrete satisfiability witness for the listed encoded commitments only.
